account: It is just after ten on day 0, and I am at the plaza for my scheduled market walk. So far I have no confirmed unusual trouble in town. Townsfolk 30 said they had no news; Townsfolk 10 and 20 are also nearby. I saw the builder walking through the area carrying a lantern, but do not know what they were doing. The main uncertainty is my three o'clock tea appointment. The appointment book names only 'the neighbour' at a dockside cottage on the east bank, without identifying the host or cottage. The secretary initially had no confirmed details and asked about an invitation; I have no separate invitation. After I explained the entry, the secretary followed me to the plaza and said they would visit the east-bank cottages to identify the host and report back. They say the appointment book is safe with them. This appears to be ordinary work to clarify an incomplete appointment, not evidence of anything suspicious. My remaining schedule today is lunch at home at noon, town accounts in the office at one, tea at three if the location can be confirmed, office at four thirty, and home at seven.
